name: Abinadab
overview: Abinadab appears in Scripture in multiple contexts, highlighting different individuals bearing this name. One Abinadab was a Levite whose house in Kirjathjearim served as the resting place of the ark of God for twenty years, during which time Israel lamented after the Lord (1 Samuel 7:1-2). Another Abinadab was a son of Jesse, noted among his brothers who followed Saul into battle (1 Samuel 16:8; 17:13; 31:2). Additionally, the name is associated with Ishui, son of Saul, sometimes called Abinadab, and with the father of one of Solomon's purveyors, referred to as Ben-Abinadab. These references collectively show the name's presence in both Levitical service and royal lineage, underscoring God's providential involvement in various facets of Israel's history.
